text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Benissimo!! Ah, a concerto of celebration 
is resounding all around us...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you seem to be in a great mood, 
Earth-san. Did something that wonderful 
happen...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Actually... just a moment ago, someone 
handed me this loose-leaf paper!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
New lyrics popped into my head, but I had 
no paper to write them on—yet right there 
was a single sheet of hope! Thanks to 
that, marvelous lyrics were born!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that happened...? But, who could that 
kind person have been...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I was totally engrossed 
myself... Hehe, perhaps it's thanks to the 
'fairies.'

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh... "Fairy"...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Still. Is this perhaps your first time 
hearing it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Um... What exactly is this 
"fairy"...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's an amabile rumor... That inside this 
classroom lives a kind-hearted “fairy”.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? The classroom windows are, like, 
super sparkly clean! When did that 
happen~!?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Lately, little moments of joy have been 
happening in the classroom... At first, 
everyone thought it was just someone being 
kind, but—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No one in the classroom has ever seen it, 
they say. Just like a perdedocce, right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, everyone says so. That it is 
all thanks to a kind 'fairy.'

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Such a rumor... That sounds like quite a 
mysterious story, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaa~!! Th-This is...! The forbidden 
top-secret notebook I accidentally left 
behind...! When did it get on the 
desk~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! Could it be the "Fairies"...!? 
Whoaa... their benevolence permeates my 
entire soul...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, the blackboard is completely 
blank☆ White, red, green! Any color at all 
is sure to look pretty.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Could this be thanks to the "Fairies" too? 
Mmm...! Marrrrvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Still-san...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: U-Um! ...This is just a guess, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Fairy'... is Still-san, isn't 
it...!?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. It seems... that way.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The things everyone was talking about... 
they were all things that resonated with 
me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I just... spent my time as I always do, 
though..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
People often tell me I have a faint 
presence... So maybe everyone just didn't 
notice me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, in that case... how about revealing 
the 'Fairy's' true identity?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so grateful to the "Fairy"... 
no, to Still-san...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Rob Roy-san. However—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, thank goodness...! To think I'd 
forget to change the water in the vase~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The water was replaced with fresh water... 
That was definitely thanks to the 
"fairies," right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder who it could be... Either way, 
thank you so much, "fairy"...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see that smile... I find myself 
thinking that maybe it's fine if they 
never notice me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
As long as there's someone it brings joy 
to, that's more than enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ! Still-san...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Besides, standing out too much is a bit 
embarrassing... so please keep this a 
secret between the two of us...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Understood! It's all thanks to a 
kindhearted "fairy", right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. I ran into Still in Love carrying 
a trash can.
choice_data_list: So this is where you throw away the trash?
Is this where you throw away the trash?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, yes. It was getting full... so I 
thought anyone wanting to throw trash away 
might have trouble..."
choice_data_list: You're truly such a kind person.
I'm sure everyone will be thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, yes. It was getting full... so I 
thought anyone wanting to throw trash away 
might have trouble..."
choice_data_list: You're truly such a kind person.
I'm sure everyone will be thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
K-Kind...? Not at all... Thank you, so 
much...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Still-san. Taking out the trash...? In 
that case, please let me help.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That is a huge help. Rob Roy-san 
is such a kind person too, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if that is the case... I am truly 
honored.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Whoa☆ The trash can is so squeaky clean! 
Maybe this is thanks to the "fairies" 
again! Ehehe... Marvelous★ gratitude to 
them☆

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
